alpha.label: Alpha
alpha.meaning: An early version: expect gaps and changes, and check results before relying on them

assumption.label: Assumption
assumption.meaning: Relies on an assumption the sources don't settle; the reason and evidence are given

beta.label: Beta
beta.meaning: Working, but built by automated steps without manual human verification

borrowed.label: Borrowed
borrowed.meaning: The source took this from another source, so it isn't independent

estimate.label: Estimate
estimate.meaning: An estimate, or labelled by its source as estimated, calculated or borrowed

translated.label: Translated
translated.meaning: A name or text translated by this site, not by the publisher

unverified.label: Not yet checked
unverified.meaning: Not yet checked line by line against the original source

blend-beta.reason: Owner's decision (18 Nov 2026): automated reviews may be used, labelled beta
blend-beta.text: Blended values are built by automated steps without manual human verification. Each value names the tables, codes and published cells it came from.

borrowed-record.text: One of these records names another table we use as its main data source, so its values count once: they are shown, but not used in the median.

definition-not-checked.reason: The defining report isn't archived yet (see standards.csv)
definition-not-checked.text: Which definition this standard's target uses isn't stated in the archived documents; the choice follows the standard's usual practice.

other-definition.reason: Better than leaving it missing; the definition used is named with the value
other-definition.text: This value uses a different definition from the one this standard's target uses, because the tables don't give that one for this food.

salt-basis-pantothenic.evidence: Across 112 foods matched in both tables, CoFID's value was a median 1.00 times USDA's (middle half 0.74–1.50): no sign of a 1.09 factor
salt-basis-pantothenic.reason: The documents don't settle the basis; owner's decision (18 Nov 2026) to combine on the data check, with this caveat shown
salt-basis-pantothenic.text: Combined on a data check. CoFID says it expresses pantothenate as calcium D-pantothenate; USDA reports pantothenic acid and doesn't say. If the two differed, CoFID's values would be about 9% higher (238.3 and 219.2 per pantothenate).

salt-basis-thiamin.evidence: Across 121 foods matched in both tables, CoFID's value was a median 1.08 times USDA's (middle half 0.76–1.78): no sign of a 1.27 factor
salt-basis-thiamin.reason: The documents don't settle the basis; owner's decision (18 Nov 2026) to combine on the data check, with this caveat shown
salt-basis-thiamin.text: Combined on a data check. CoFID says it expresses thiamin as thiamine chloride hydrochloride; USDA doesn't say. If the two differed, CoFID's values would be about 27% higher (molar masses 337.3 and 265.4).

salt-basis-vitaminB6.evidence: Across 114 foods matched in both tables, CoFID's value was a median 0.96 times USDA's (middle half 0.54–1.23): no sign of a 1.22 factor
salt-basis-vitaminB6.reason: The documents don't settle the basis; owner's decision (18 Nov 2026) to combine on the data check, with this caveat shown
salt-basis-vitaminB6.text: Combined on a data check. CoFID says it expresses vitamin B6 as pyridoxine hydrochloride; USDA doesn't say. If the two differed, CoFID's values would be about 22% higher (molar masses 205.6 and 169.2).

CHOAVLDF.label: Carbohydrate (by difference, without fibre)
CHOAVLDF.meaning: Available carbohydrate by difference: 100 minus water, protein, fat, ash, alcohol and total dietary fibre

CHOAVLM.label: Carbohydrate (available, as monosaccharides)
CHOAVLM.meaning: Available carbohydrate as the sum of analysed starch, sugars and oligosaccharides, in monosaccharide equivalents (about 5-10% above weight for starch and disaccharides)

CHOCDF.label: Carbohydrate (by difference, with fibre)
CHOCDF.meaning: Carbohydrate by difference, including fibre (used where the food has no fibre value)

ENERC_KCAL:atwater-specific.label: Energy (US Atwater factors)
ENERC_KCAL:atwater-specific.meaning: Energy from protein, fat and carbohydrate (by difference) with Atwater food-specific factors; for multi-ingredient processed foods, industry factors 4/4/9

ENERC_KCAL:uk-factors.label: Energy (UK factors)
ENERC_KCAL:uk-factors.meaning: Energy from protein 4, fat 9, available carbohydrate as monosaccharide equivalents 3.75 and alcohol 7 kcal/g; no energy from fibre (the UK convention; not the EU labelling factors)

F18D2.label: C18:2 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
F18D2.meaning: C18:2, isomers not separated (includes trans and other forms), per 100 g food

F18D2CN6.label: Linoleic acid
F18D2CN6.meaning: Linoleic acid: cis,cis n-6 C18:2, per 100 g food

F18D3.label: C18:3 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
F18D3.meaning: C18:3, isomers not separated (includes gamma-linolenic acid), per 100 g food

F18D3CN3.label: Alpha-linolenic acid
F18D3CN3.meaning: Alpha-linolenic acid: cis n-3 C18:3, per 100 g food

F20D5.label: C20:5 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
F20D5.meaning: C20:5, isomers not separated, per 100 g food

F20D5N3.label: EPA
F20D5N3.meaning: EPA: n-3 C20:5, per 100 g food

F22D6.label: C22:6 fatty acids (isomers not separated)
F22D6.meaning: C22:6, isomers not separated, per 100 g food

F22D6N3.label: DHA
F22D6N3.meaning: DHA: n-3 C22:6, per 100 g food

FASAT.label: Saturated fat
FASAT.meaning: Total saturated fatty acids per 100 g food

FAT.label: Fat
FAT.meaning: Total fat (all lipid components extracted), not only triglycerides

FAT:nlea.label: Fat (US label definition)
FAT:nlea.meaning: Total fatty acids expressed as triglycerides (US label fat)

FIBTG.label: Fibre (AOAC)
FIBTG.meaning: Total dietary fibre by AOAC enzymatic-gravimetric methods (includes resistant starch and lignin)

FOL.label: Folate (total)
FOL.meaning: Total folate (food folate + any folic acid), by weight

FOLDFE.label: Folate (dietary folate equivalents)
FOLDFE.meaning: Dietary folate equivalents: food folate + 1.7 x folic acid

PANTAC.label: Pantothenic acid
PANTAC.meaning: Pantothenic acid. CoFID expresses it as calcium D-pantothenate; USDA doesn't state the form (combined on a data check: caveat salt-basis-pantothenic)

PROCNT.label: Protein
PROCNT.meaning: Total nitrogen x a food-specific conversion factor (6.25 unless stated); non-protein nitrogen removed for mushrooms

SUGAR.label: Sugars (by weight)
SUGAR.meaning: Total free mono- and disaccharides, by weight

SUGARM.label: Sugars (as monosaccharides)
SUGARM.meaning: Total free mono- and disaccharides in monosaccharide equivalents (disaccharides counted about 5% heavier)

THIA.label: Thiamin
THIA.meaning: Thiamin. CoFID expresses it as thiamine chloride hydrochloride; USDA doesn't state the form (combined on a data check: caveat salt-basis-thiamin)

VITA.label: Vitamin A (retinol equivalents)
VITA.meaning: Retinol equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene/6 + other provitamin A carotenoids/12

VITA_RAE.label: Vitamin A (retinol activity equivalents)
VITA_RAE.meaning: Retinol activity equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene/12 + other provitamin A carotenoids/24 (IOM 2001)

VITB6.label: Vitamin B6
VITB6.meaning: Vitamin B6. CoFID expresses it as pyridoxine hydrochloride; USDA doesn't state the form (combined on a data check: caveat salt-basis-vitaminB6)

VITC.label: Vitamin C
VITC.meaning: Total vitamin C: ascorbic acid + dehydroascorbic acid

VITD:with-25OHD3.label: Vitamin D (including 25-hydroxy D3)
VITD:with-25OHD3.meaning: Vitamin D3 + 5 x 25-hydroxy vitamin D3 (vitamin D activity, meat)

VITE.label: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol equivalents)
VITE.meaning: Alpha-tocopherol equivalents (other tocopherols and tocotrienols weighted by activity)
